name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. It balances visibility for keyboard users without overwhelming the interface, keeping touch targets clear on mobile. The trade-off is slightly lower visibility than the 7:1 option, but it avoids visual clutter and works better for reduced-motion users.

name: Reader
text: The 6:1 ring still fails for monochrome or high-contrast users—it vanishes when colors invert or when the ring’s contrast drops below 6:1 in those modes. A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast survives inversion and reduced motion, but risks crowding on small touch targets. Test both on a monochrome phone in inverted mode; the one that remains visible wins.
